snippet.title: Banana Cowboy: The Wild Bunch - Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist Banana Cowboy: The Wild Bunch now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3554200/Banana_Cowboy_The_Wild_Bunch/

Discord- https://discord.com/invite/tdVPt45ssV?fbclid=PAQ0xDSwPL4ZRleHRuA2FlbQIxMQBzcnRjBmFwcF9pZA8xMjQwMjQ1NzQyODc0MTQAAafKlKMDw97Z0q2iWtjfKAos_9-XIVoy4nH6Cu13RRHUJGkWICyeQo0lQuPrjQ_aem_4ifxPTmlw7FofIEj28VLYg
Instagram- https://www.instagram.com/berryripegames/
TikTok- https://www.tiktok.com/@berryripegames?is_from_webapp=1&sender_device=pc

Betrayed by his friends during a botched train heist, Banana Cowboy reinvents himself as a deputy on the tiny planet of Durian Gap. Life is good out on the galactic frontier… until the past comes knocking. Now, Banana Cowboy races to catch his former comrades before the law can catch him. Our hero is aided in his quest by Pete- the lazy, philosophizing sheriff of Durian Gap- and former girlfriend Rio - an explosive bank robbing banana pepper.

Can our heroes catch the bad guys in time? Find out in Banana Cowboy: The Wild Bunch!

 #indiegame #games #gamedev #bananacowboy
